title: Shader Development Studio
promptLanguage: Drive one full-viewport Three.js scene with a Lenis scroll value, and let the current frame sample the next scene so a monitor or a torn edge reveals what follows. Render only the sections in view, and finish the composite with a light film grain.
notes: The studio page is one canvas from the opening scene through a work reel, a story, and a contact close, with smooth scroll snapping between the first two and a grain grade on the final composite. Scenes outside the scroll window do not draw, and the next one starts a little early so the handoff has a texture to sample.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion shows the hero, work, story, and contact as still frames in order and skips the scroll snap, the scene sampling, and the grain pass.
creditLine: Shader Development Studio, Andreas Antonsson, Shader Development Studio (https://thefwa.com/cases/shader-development-studio)
